story.vex: One wall. One trick. I only need to find it once. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED, and the next one too: three independent layers now stand where there was only one. Astro: "Not the same wall three times. Three different walls."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
The relay console has only its firewall — one layer. Read audit.txt, then add three more, different, layers: close the leftover diagnostic port, disable the unused legacy account, and lock the engine specs file away from ordinary crew.

1. type audit.txt
2. netstat -an   (confirm port 9091 is open)
3. taskkill /im diag-legacy.exe /f
4. net user legacy-diag /active:no
5. icacls engine-specs.txt /deny cadet:F
files.C:\\Citadel\\audit.txt:
SINGLE-LAYER AUDIT
--------------------
Only the perimeter firewall is active. Three more layers are missing:
1. Host: a leftover diagnostic service (diag-legacy.exe) still listens on port 9091.
2. Host: a legacy account 'legacy-diag' from a retired console is still enabled.
3. Data: engine-specs.txt is CONFIDENTIAL but readable by everyone.
files.C:\\Citadel\\engine-specs.txt: CONFIDENTIAL — Rivet's engine specifications. Should be locked to Rivet only.

steps.title: Read the single-layer audit
steps.body: Rivet: "One wall isn't depth. Read what's missing." `type audit.txt`.

steps.title: Add three different layers
steps.body: Volt: "Three different walls, not one wall three times." Stop the leftover service (`taskkill /im diag-legacy.exe /f`), disable the legacy account (`net user legacy-diag /active:no`), and lock the specs file (`icacls engine-specs.txt /deny cadet:F`).
